evidence.detail: The static startup method creates the process/root Guice Injector from rs/p/b, resolves and installs the singleton Launcher, resolves this bootstrap class itself, then invokes its startup lifecycle; the injector is retained statically and exposed through c().

The instance startup method initializes the injected configuration/plugin subsystem, loads plugins, initializes UI, registers UI/plugin/config objects on EventBus, starts plugins/UI and finally initializes the rs/A/q client event bridge.
Static initialization derives ~/.spawnpk-data plus exact child directories 'plugins' and 'screenshots', fixing this class at application bootstrap scope rather than a narrow gameplay subsystem.
Exact-v308 reverse references include Client, Launcher, ScriptPacketDispatcher and the plugin manager path; this is live shared application infrastructure rather than dormant utility code.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the root client application/injector bootstrap and startup coordinator. No original stripped identifier is claimed.

evidence.detail: The class directly extends com.google.inject.AbstractModule and is the sole module supplied to ClientApplicationBootstrap's root Guice.createInjector call.

configure() binds named developerMode/safeMode flags, a concrete Client singleton instance, ScheduledExecutorService, plugin/config/UI services, a JSON/Gson-like serializer, the primary EventBus and the named 'Deferred EventBus' binding to DeferredEventBus.
Its @Provides @Singleton method resolves rs/s/h from the injected configuration/service manager, making this module the central composition root for application services.
The only exact-v308 external owner of this module is rs/p/a ClientApplicationBootstrap, which constructs it specifically to create the root application Injector.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the root Guice application module paired with ClientApplicationBootstrap.
